description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_SetDebugTemplate, which is a method implementation for setting the debug template within the Smarty templating engine. It includes a method setDebugTemplate() that assigns a debug template to a Smarty object, handling validation and potential exceptions.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_SetDebugTemplate
classes.description: A class implementing the Smarty method to set the debug template, providing functionality to assign a debug template to a Smarty object with validation.

methods.name: setDebugTemplate
methods.description: Sets the debug template for a Smarty object, validating file readability and handling exceptions if the file cannot be read.
